def fit_rank(M, rs=range(30,130,2), trials=3):
    s=np.linalg.svd(M,compute_uv=False)[:-1]  # drop LN null
    n=len(s); out=[]
    for r in rs:
        tail=s[r:]
        m=n-r
        sims=np.mean([np.linalg.svd(rng.standard_normal((384,m)),compute_uv=False) for _ in range(trials)],0)
        sig=(tail@sims)/(sims@sims)
        err=np.mean((tail-sig*sims)**2)/np.mean(tail**2)
        out.append((r,round(err,4),round(sig,4)))
    return out
